title: Evaluating and Improving the Coreference Capabilities of Machine Translation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation performance on datasets with stereotypical and anti-stereotypical gender role assignments (e.g., WinoMT, BUG). The paper measures bias using target-side consistency and gender accuracy metrics, specifically calculating the performance differences between stereotypical vs. non-stereotypical roles (ΔS) and between source sentences containing male vs. female entities (ΔG).
